name: Kneadra
author: enobale
description: Plan pizza dough right from your bar: pick size, crust, and how long it'll ferment, and get exact grams of flour, water, salt, oil, and yeast, on a live recipe card with a to-scale pizza. Handles same-day, overnight, and multi-day cold ferments.

barWidget.description: Pizza dough planner: size, crust, and ferment time in, exact grams out
